description: SLS §3.4's idle edge is applied once, at the pipeline layer, to the shift engine's trend, using the structure engine's reported condition — and only on the two edges §3.4 draws. Neither engine can do it alone: shift holds the trend but detects no BOS and reads no events; structure holds the bracket, closes and breaks but its own trend_state has no production consumer; and shift cannot import structure (structure_replay.py:17 already imports trend_after from it).
